tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search UK company register information, not businesses advertised for sale. Research is free while the API-key gate is disabled; when enabled, the applicable allowance and prepaid tariff apply. Requires a Sell Ltd API key. Research requests are metered under the current allowance and prepaid tariff.

tools.name: calculate_valuation

tools.name: search_marketplace
tools.description: Browse active public teasers. Full details require a buyer-signed NDA.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Read a listing by slug. Signed NDA/owner access is enforced. If locked, return a human NDA signing URL.

tools.name: list_my_listings
tools.description: List the connected owner’s adverts. Requires account:read. Requires connected account authorization with account:read.

tools.name: get_my_listing
tools.description: Read an owned listing draft. Requires account:read. Requires connected account authorization with account:read.

tools.name: save_listing
tools.description: Create or patch an owned draft with all supplied details. Requires listings:write. Never publishes. An existing draft requires id and expectedVersion. Requires connected account authorization with listings:write.

tools.name: validate_listing
tools.description: Return missing publication fields and advertising eligibility. Requires connected account authorization with account:read.

tools.name: publish_listing
tools.description: Make the advert public using the owner’s explicitly delegated listings:publish permission. Trial/payment and all publication checks apply. Requires connected account authorization with listings:publish.

tools.name: pause_listing
tools.description: Pause an owned advert. Advertising time continues to run. Requires connected account authorization with listings:write.

tools.name: create_media_upload
tools.description: Get a signed upload URL. Upload bytes directly to that URL, then call complete_media_upload. Files remain private until permitted by listing visibility. Requires connected account authorization with media:write.

tools.name: complete_media_upload
tools.description: Validate and attach previously uploaded media. Requires connected account authorization with media:write.

tools.name: quote_advertising
tools.description: Get a one-off quote for 7–365 advertising days. Does not charge. Requires connected account authorization with account:read.

tools.name: create_advertising_checkout
tools.description: Return a Stripe Checkout link for the person to approve and pay. Never charges a saved card automatically. Requires connected account authorization with listings:write.

tools.name: list_saved_searches
tools.description: Read the connected account’s buyer alerts. Requires connected account authorization with account:read.

tools.name: save_search_alert
tools.description: Create or edit a saved search and its explicit alert frequency; existing account limits apply. Requires alerts:write. Requires connected account authorization with alerts:write.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_listing, create_media_upload · Private data: search_companies, get_company, calculate_valuation, create_media_upload · Public sink: publish_listing, create_media_upload, complete_media_upload · Destructive: pause_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_listing, create_media_upload · Private data: search_companies, get_company, calculate_valuation, create_media_upload · Public sink: publish_listing, create_media_upload, complete_media_upload · Destructive: pause_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
